game_title: Capstone Boss Chain – Sandstorm Pass Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass, a pass in a sandstorm: the caravan guide must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Capstone Boss Chain: Beat a boss with phases that each demand a different skill from earlier weeks.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sandstorm Pass: a pass in a sandstorm
core_gameplay_loop: In Sandstorm Pass, repeat each round: Beat a boss with phases that each demand a different skill from earlier weeks. Each round, scarab swarms strike the sundial, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the boss_hp value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the sundial from scarab swarms in Sandstorm Pass: keep the boss_hp meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: boss_hp drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 5 (applied tier): Capstone Boss Chain
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Capstone Boss Chain' (Week 9 slot 15), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Sandstorm Pass'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how boss_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against scarab swarms in Sandstorm Pass.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while boss_hp > 0.
